newsitem.title: USA: BT /MCI deal to curb renegotiation-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: BT /MCI deal to curb renegotiation-WSJ.

text.p: The pact British Telecommunications Plc signed to buy MCI Communications rules out using the performance of MCI's local phone business as a "materially adverse" event that could trigger renegotiation, The Wall Street Journal said.

In Wednesday's electronic edition, the newspaper cites "executives close to both companies" who say the contract for the $21 billion acquisition includes a crucial exemption that would seem to neutralize concerns that British Telecommunications might try to renegotiate its deal.
The Journal said neither company would comment on the purchase agreement, but the article quotes one executive saying the exemption is clearly stated in the contract both companies signed.
And the article says two contract extensions written into the purchase agreement bind both companies to the agreement until midspring, according to "a person familiar with the document."
